Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 100,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A Snapshot of Your Day As a Working Student in the Cybersecurity Services team, you will support the delivery of cybersecurity services for IT and OT environments, including industrial and energy systems. You will help with vulnerability management, security assessments and cybersecurity documentation. All hands-on technical work takes place on digital twins and replica environments, never on live customer systems. This lets you build practical skills in a safe, realistic setting. How Youll Make an Impact Support vulnerability management activities on digital twins and replica environments by running scans, analysing findings, tracking remediation efforts, and preparing structured vulnerability reports. Assist with IT/OT security and risk assessments through information gathering, system documentation reviews, and the documentation of findings and recommendations. Help develop, maintain, and update cybersecurity policies, procedures, and supporting documentation in alignment with frameworks such as NIS2 and IEC 62443. Support system hardening activities by preparing and applying hardening checklists and performing CIS Benchmark checks for Windows and Linux systems in test environments. Contribute to customer deliverables, including reports, presentations, and service materials, by preparing input, structuring content, and ensuring consistent quality standards. Create security awareness and training materials that explain cybersecurity concepts in a clear and accessible manner, while developing small automations and scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Excel-based reporting) to improve the efficiency of recurring tasks and reporting. What You Bring Currently enrolled in a Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Automation/Control Engineering, Electrical/Power Engineering, or a related field. No formal work experience required; however, university projects, home labs, or personal IT/cybersecurity projects are considered an advantage. Basic knowledge of networking concepts (TCP/IP, IP addressing, VLANs, routing and switching) and Windows/Linux server administration. Interest in Operational Technology (OT) environments and industrial protocols such as IEC 61850, IEC 62443, and Modbus is a plus. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with a structured approach to work and great attention to detail. Very good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and strong English communication skills, both written and spoken. About the Team Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the worlds electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Office Siemens Energys location in One Cotroceni Park is more than just an office space - its a hub for a vibrant and thriving community. Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the perfect place to work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier. Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities.
